title: Environment area
description: A semantic zone as stored: a box area, or an operating area that also carries geodetic geometry and an altitude band.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the environment and type.

name.description: Display name. May be empty: readers then show a numbered fallback.

position.description: Position in the environment frame, metres.

rotation.description: Orientation as a quaternion. Writers are expected to keep it unit length; the schema cannot say so.

size.description: Box extents along the world axes, metres.

locked.description: Whether the editor refuses to move it.

geometry.description: Geodetic polygon of an operating area (type, vertices, holes). Its ring rules stay with the platform.

role.description: Operating-area role. The allowed values stay with the platform.

altitude_reference.description: What floor_m and ceiling_m are measured from.

floor_m.description: Lower altitude bound, metres above the geo anchor.

ceiling_m.description: Upper altitude bound, metres above the geo anchor.

source.description: Where an imported area came from.
